idea-plugin.name: Skein - Claude Code Threads
idea-plugin.description:
Skein keeps your Claude Code CLI sessions as threads next to your code. A side panel lists the project's sessions, shows which one waits for you, and notifies you when a turn ends or a permission prompt comes up.

  • Each thread is an ordinary IDE terminal tab in the editor area, running your own unmodified claude.
  • Each thread's state, model and context use at a glance.
  • Resume past sessions from the History; pin, name and mark them done.
  • Start threads in git worktrees, and keep, open or remove the worktrees they leave.
  • Closing a thread's tab ends its claude cleanly, so no session keeps running behind a closed tab.

That last point works around a bug in the IDE's terminal, IJPL-259859 - when a tab closes, the IDE keeps its terminal connection open but stops reading it, so a claude still running there never exits. Its session still looks in use, and resuming it warns that it runs elsewhere. Until JetBrains fixes it, Skein sends claude and the tab's shell the hangup signal a closing terminal would send, waits up to five seconds for them to exit while the tab is still open, and only then closes the tab. A claude you start in a plain terminal tab, outside Skein, is still left behind.

Skein adds no hooks or settings to Claude Code. Needs Claude Code 2.1.162 or newer. Tested on macOS, and Linux is supported but has seen less use. Windows is not supported yet - on Windows, and for projects in WSL or Remote Development, Skein turns itself off and says why. Unofficial, not affiliated with Anthropic.
